ORUN

v35 · ERROR CATCHER

The duel. Pick your fighter, then spin the wheel to meet your foe. Two cards are dealt — play one face-down, roll the D12 — land in your card's range and it fires. Empty roll? The die's twelve fates decide: wounds, armor, gold, health, and stranger things. Best all eight fighters to claim the table.

Hands: pinch to grab cards, coins & the die · touch buttons, the deck & portraits · −/+ set table height.
